## Checklist

- [ ] The change is focused and contains no unrelated generated files.
- [ ] Behavior changes include tests or an explanation of why tests are not applicable.
- [ ] Public API/support/roadmap/changelog documentation is updated where relevant.
- [ ] No unsupported feature is presented as available.
- [ ] New assets include source, creator/rightsholder, license, attribution, modification history, and redistribution evidence.
- [ ] I have the right to submit this contribution under the repository license.
